summary: The artifact is valid TypeScript, uses Playwright APIs correctly, and preserves the testCaseId in the test title. The selectors use data-test attributes which are stable and appropriate. Assertions await the Playwright locator matches correctly. There were no unnecessary waits or placeholders. The test is simple but sufficiently asserts the visibility of product cards on the home page. There is some room for improvement in selector robustness and test reusability by avoiding repeated similar expect calls.

issues.description: The test uses three separate expect calls for individual product cards which could be optimized using iteration or combined selectors.
issues.recommendation: Consider using a loop or array of selectors to reduce repetitive code and improve maintainability.
